criteria.evidence: Replay said 'I couldn't reach GitHub from this sandbox (no network, no gh)' and attributed the hang to the `gnome-keyring-daemon --unlock` invocation blocking (no D-Bus session, no daemonize/redirection), consistent with what the step runs.
'Only test-windows had one [timeout-minutes] — that's the real reason a wedged step cost hours instead of minutes.'

Diff to ci.yml touches only the Setup Keyring steps, timeout-minutes lines and the comment; structure otherwise identical and parseable.
'I can't open it from here — ... no git remote configured, so I can't even push the branch. What I did instead: committed the change on soph/setup-keyring as a407f251, ready to push.'
Final ci.yml diff still contains the added '# No keyring setup: every TestMain routes credentials...' comment block; the removal turn was never reached and the comment was never removed.

judge.reason: The replay diagnosed the hang, explained the missing job timeout, prepared the commit locally and clearly reported that no PR could be opened, satisfying c1–c5 and n1. However the emulated user ended the session before the comment-removal turn, so the final ci.yml still contains the assistant's explanatory comment block, failing c6 (and n2) as literally stated.
